programme.title: RISE OF THE LEGEND [English Dub]
programme.desc: Rise of the Legend is a kung-fu action story about a young martial artist who infiltrates a powerful criminal gang to bring down its tyrannical leader. Starring Eddie Peng, Sammo Hung, Wang Luodan. In 1868 Guangzhou, young Wong Fei-hung proves his deadly skills to gain the trust of the ruthless Black Tiger gang leader. However, Fei-hung harbors a secret past and works covertly to dismantle the syndicate and free the oppressed port.

programme.title: ICEMAN: THE TIME TRAVELER [English Dub]
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind

programme.title: Revolver [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ha Su Yeong, a police detective who went to prison for someone else, is surprised when a mysterious woman named Jung Yun Seon arrives to collect her on her day of release. As she discovers that the promised compensation for her time behind bars has vanished, Su Yeong embarks on a mission to reclaim what rightfully belongs to her. Su Yeong uncovers that the man behind it all is Andy and embarks on a relentless pursuit. Fueled by her unwavering belief that 'promises must be kept', Su Yeong charges toward her singular goal...

programme.title: The Naked Kitchen [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Today is Mo-rae and Sang-in’s one-year wedding anniversary. Mo-rae goes to an art gallery to find a gift for Sang-in, where she meets a stranger and the two unexpectedly have sex. That night, Du-rae visits them to help Sang-in with his new business. To Mo-rae’s shock, he is the man from the gallery. He temporarily lives with the couple and a love triangle begins.

programme.title: Triple Tap [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Champion competitive marksman Ken comes across an armored van robbery. He sees a policeman held hostage and shoots and kills four of the robbers. One of the robbers escapes and the policeman survives. The case is handled by Jerry Chang, whom Ken knows from having recently beaten him in a shooting match. Ken is found not guilty in court. Soon after, Ken is attacked by the escaped robber Pang Tao. Their confrontation reveals a very different background story and brings about a myriad of lies and traps and changes in relationships as Jerry and Ken try to outsmart each other.

programme.title: The Terror Live [English Dub]
programme.desc: A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.

programme.title: BLAZING FISTS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ikuto and Ryoma meet in juvenile detention and become best friends, they pursue their dream of participating in the martial arts event Breaking Down. However, rivalries soon turn their dreams into unexpected conflicts.

programme.title: SHAOLIN [English Dub]
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: 11 REBELS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Amidst the Boshin War's brutal conflicts, a motley squad of criminals and samurai undertakes a desperate defense of a fortress, their stand triggered by clashing interests of the Shibata clan, the shogunate, and the new government.

programme.title: SPECIAL ID [English Dub]
programme.desc: A cop goes undercover in a ruthless underworld organization to stop a gang leader, only to put himself in great danger after being exposed by his former protégé and best friend.

programme.title: SAMURAI FURY [English Dub]
programme.desc: In 15th century Kyoto before the Onin War, outlaw leader Hyoe uses his deadly swordsmanship to spearhead a rebellion against the corrupt Shogunate and its army, commanded by his former friend and now enemy Doken.

programme.title: THE GREAT WAR OF ARCHIMEDES [English Dub]
programme.desc: It is the early 1930s and the command of the Japanese Imperial Navy determines to construct the world's biggest and most formidable battleship, Yamato. One of the admirals, Yamamoto Isoroku, disagrees. He recruits the upstart and mathematics' expert Tadashi Kai who discovers there are discrepancies between the official cost estimates and the actual figures. They soon find out that they have stumbled upon a conspiracy.

programme.title: THE WITCH 2: THE OTHER ONE [English Dub]
programme.desc: After escaping from a secluded laboratory, a young girl with overwhelming power finds herself on the run from several mysterious organizations, seeking refuge with a woman and her younger brother.

programme.title: Dr. Cheon and Lost Talisman [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The story of a fake exorcist, Dr. Cheon, who is commissioned for the case of a girl who is strongly possessed.

programme.title: ONE-PERCENT WARRIOR [English Dub]
programme.desc: A famed action hero films his own film on territory claimed by other yakuza gangs, including Japan's toughest martial arts assassin, after his devastatingly quick, samurai-style fighting technique turns filmmakers against him.

programme.title: SAKURAN [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A young girl is sold into a red-light district brothel and tries to adapt to life and meke her own way as an No.1 oiran (courtesan).

programme.title: Bad City [English Dub]
programme.desc: In a city riddled with corruption, a secret team is put together to bring down a mobster running for mayor. Backstabbings and betrayals galore in this intense thriller.

programme.title: Lost In Thailand [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The film is about three Chinese men traveling in Thailand: two competing scientists searching for their boss, and a tourist eager to explore the country.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story follows three friends who discover they have the power to travel back and forth 20 years with a sneeze. However, the future is not as good as they hoped, and they need to take on the responsibility of saving the world.

programme.title: FLASH POINT [English Dub]
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Ma Jun, known for dispensing his own brand of justice during arrests, teams up with an undercover cop, Wilson, to try and bring down three merciless Vietnamese brothers running a smuggling ring in the months before mainland China's takeover of Hong Kong. Jun pursues the gang tirelessly, sometimes ignoring police protocols. A showdown is inevitable!

programme.title: Exhuma [English Dub]
programme.desc: Feng shui master Kim Sang-deok joins a shaman and a mortician to relocate a cursed ancestral grave, but the excavation unearths a colonial atrocity buried beneath the soil, forcing crew into a brutal confrontation with an immortal warrior.

programme.title: THE OLD WOMAN WITH THE KNIFE [English Dub]
programme.desc: An aging assassin with a knack for taking out society's worst encounters a young protégé eager to learn the trade. As they form an unlikely bond, the veteran killer discovers fresh purpose in her twilight years of violence and routine.

programme.title: EYE FOR AN EYE: THE BLIND SWORDSMAN [English Dub]
programme.desc: The story focuses on Visually impaired but nonetheless lethal bounty hunter Cheng Xiazi who happened upon the assaulted Ni Yan, the lone survivor of a brutal massacre that claimed her whole family.

programme.title: EYE FOR AN EYE 2: BLIND VENGEANCE [English Dub]
programme.desc: A blind swordsman reluctantly mentors an orphan seeking vengeance for his destroyed family, teaching him martial arts skills. The orphan waits for an opportunity to avenge his kin.
